sloka: मम हेतोः पराक्रान्ता ये गता यमसादनम् ।ते सर्वे जिवितं प्राप्य समुत्तिष्ठन्तु वानराः ।। ६.१२३.५ ।।
transliteration: mama hetoḥ parākrāntā ye gatā yamasādanam ।te sarve jivitaṁ prāpya samuttiṣṭhantu vānarāḥ ।। 6.123.5 ।।

translations.english: "The Vanaras have fought for my cause and reached the abode of Yama. Make them rise up and get them back to life."
